data.name: Sadhil
data.gender_notes: Sadhil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sadhil', meaning 'Learned, Wise, Scholar'. A name for a boy who is expected to grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable individual. The name Sadhil carries the meaning “Learned, Wise, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Sadhil usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, wise, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner wisdom and knowledge that one gains through spiritual practice and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Sadhil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned, Wise, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadhil total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sadhil carries a rich cultural heritage in Hindu mythology and traditions. In the Hindu society, knowledge, wisdom and education have always held high respect. A boy named Sadhil is culturally expected to carry forward this tradition, to grow up to be a learned and wise individual. This name inspires a child towards intellectual pursuits, and the societal pressure to excel in education can greatly influence the child's academic success.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sadhil represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, which is crucial for attaining enlightenment and self-realization. The name encourages the individual to seek knowledge not just for the sake of social prestige, but for the spiritual growth and self-improvement. Sadhil is a name for a spiritual warrier, who bravely battles the ignorance and barbarism of the world through education and enlightenment. It serves as a constant reminder of the importance of wisdom and knowledge in one's spiritual journey towards the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sadhil: One devoted to the path of truth and self-realization. Consistently striving towards inner peace and enlightenment.
